metadata.description: Verzth's curated Claude Code skills — humanoid-thinking framework, Go microservices, AI-First Product Management, AI-First Engineering Management, and more. Available via npm and Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: humanoid-thinking
plugins.description: Human cognitive framework — default mode for all interactions. Intuition-first thinking validated by logic. Confirms over assumes when ambiguous.

plugins.name: golang-developer
plugins.description: Go microservices development with Clean Architecture, GORM, gRPC + grpc-gateway, Wire DI, NATS JetStream, Redis, MySQL. Covers scaffolding, code review, debugging, testing.

plugins.name: pm-thinking
plugins.description: AI-First Product Management bundle — pm-discover (synthesize research), pm-works (write PRD with Tech Implications), pm-decide (multi-mode: prio/review/stakeholder/retro). Tech-literate, with explicit handoff to engineer-manager. English-only since v1.5.0.

plugins.name: em-thinking
plugins.description: AI-First Engineering Management bundle — em-plan (architectural plan with risk tier T0-T3, scope challenge, invariants, failure modes, test strategy, dual output edd.md + edd.html), em-works (execution-ready handoff: atomic tickets with AI compute class + token estimates, worktree lanes, env/secrets spec, deploy plan artifact, dual eng-works.md + eng-works.html), em-review (Mode A code review + Mode B hypothesis-driven debug, dual .md + .html for all modes). Companion to pm-thinking. Role-based handoff (engineer/security-reviewer/qa-reviewer/release-engineer/devops). English-only since v1.5.0.

plugins.name: arch-diagram
plugins.description: Interactive system diagram generator — self-contained HTML files with no build step. Flowchart/architecture diagrams use Cytoscape.js (fully editable: drag nodes, add/remove nodes and edges, rename labels, bend connection lines). Sequence diagrams are custom SVG with gradient actors, phase bands, numbered steps, and a legend. ER/state/class diagrams use Mermaid. All diagrams include zoom/pan, dark/light theme, click-to-explore node details, and SVG/PNG/PDF export.

plugins.name: public-awareness
plugins.description: Artifact integrity guardrail — keeps internal working context (progress notes, TODOs, uncertainty, session reasoning) out of public-facing artifacts: websites, API specs, technical documentation, databases, and shared documents. Routes internal context to TodoWrite (in-session) or memory (cross-session). Applies to all contexts where AI writes to any external or shared system.
